responsibility: Implements the device-registration and channel-allocation infrastructure for gm2 ISO I/O. It owns the DeviceId registry, per-device channel membership tracking via RTentity, default not-available hook procedures, initialization and destruction of DeviceTable records, channel creation/uncreation through RTio, and the helper used by device modules to validate ownership and raise IOChan exceptions, thereby providing the plumbing that concrete devices like sockets, memory streams, and program arguments build on.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements the IOLink plumbing: it manages the device-id registry and per-device channel sets, initializes default DeviceTable hooks, creates and destroys channel/device-table bindings, and raises wrong-device/device exceptions, whereas IOLink.def just defines those contracts and record layouts.
